title: Home Purchase Agreement Replacement Funds: Additional Deposit Due and Held
content:
**Escrow memo — replacement funds for a returned deposit payment on a Home Purchase Agreement.**

**1. Additional deposit rate.** The additional deposit rate is the collection's additional deposit percentage.

**2. Additional deposit due.** The additional deposit due is the contract price times the additional deposit rate (as a percent), rounded half up to the cent.

**3. Additional deposit held.** The additional deposit the agreement still holds is every additional deposit posted less every additional deposit returned unpaid, as the agreement ledger shows them.

**4. Replacement funds.** The replacement funds are the additional deposit due less the additional deposit held. The replacement funds as finally figured are never less than zero — a figure below zero is taken as zero — and are rounded half up to the cent; the floor and the rounding apply once, to the final figure.

The collection's additional deposit percentage is the figure on the Home Purchase Agreement deposit schedule for the agreement's collection.

## Worked figures (hypothetical agreements)

| | Agreement A | Agreement B | Agreement C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Contract price | 600000.00 | 600000.00 | 412345.67 |
| Additional deposit rate (hypothetical collection figure) | 2.0 percent | 2.0 percent | 1.0 percent |
| Additional deposit due | 12000.00 | 12000.00 | 4123.46 (4123.4567 rounded half up) |
| Additional deposits posted | 12000.00 | 6000.00 and 6000.00 | 4123.46 |
| Additional deposits returned unpaid | 12000.00 | 6000.00 | 0.00 |
| Additional deposit held | 0.00 | 6000.00 | 4123.46 |
| Replacement funds | 12000.00 | 6000.00 | 0.00 |

**Questions answered.**

*Which price is used?* The agreement's contract price, the base price plus the lot premium, as it stands on the agreement.

*Do refunded or forfeited amounts enter the additional deposit held?* The additional deposit held is figured from the additional deposits posted and those returned unpaid.
